# ibee_compute_plans (Data Source)

Compute catalog plans as the API returns them. Selectability and pricing status can differ between billing intervals.

<!-- Generated by scripts/generate_docs.py; edit schema descriptions in Go. -->

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "ibee_compute_plans" "cloud" {
  vm_type          = "cloud"
  site_id          = "SITE_ID"
  billing_interval = "HOURLY"
}
```

## Schema

| Attribute | Type | Behavior | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `billing_interval` | `string` | Optional | Catalog billing interval, such as HOURLY or MONTHLY. Omit to use the API's default. |
| `currency` | `string` | Optional | Catalog currency, such as INR. Omit to use the API's default. |
| `plans` | `list(object)` | Read-only |  |
| `plans.billing_interval` | `string` | Read-only |  |
| `plans.code` | `string` | Read-only |  |
| `plans.cpu` | `number` | Read-only |  |
| `plans.currency` | `string` | Read-only |  |
| `plans.disk_gb` | `number` | Read-only |  |
| `plans.gpu_count` | `number` | Read-only |  |
| `plans.gpu_model` | `string` | Read-only |  |
| `plans.hourly_price_minor` | `number` | Read-only |  |
| `plans.monthly_price_minor` | `number` | Read-only |  |
| `plans.name` | `string` | Read-only |  |
| `plans.plan_id` | `string` | Read-only |  |
| `plans.pricing_status` | `string` | Read-only |  |
| `plans.ram_mb` | `number` | Read-only |  |
| `plans.selectable` | `bool` | Read-only |  |
| `site_id` | `string` | Optional | Restrict plans to one placement site. |
| `vm_type` | `string` | Optional, Defaulted | cloud (default) or gpu. |
